name: Groop
summary: Folders of apps in your Dock, opening as glass grids
description:
Groop puts a few apps behind one tile of the Dock. Click the tile and the folder opens above it as a glass window, with its apps in a grid, a list or tiles, over as many pages as it needs.

The studio designs both the tile and the window: presets, a classic grid, a stack or a folder icon, colours, opacity, gloss, the header, fonts, corners, columns and density. Every size is exact: icons, text, gaps, margins, corners and the folder itself. Pictures with parallax, extra pages, a detachable window and a Command Center tile. Each folder gets a keyboard shortcut that opens it from anywhere.
